name: praxis
description: Runs one feature through plan, design, test-first build, and fresh-context review as stacked PRs, stopping at local commits until told to push.

interface.shortDescription: One feature from requirements to reviewed, stacked PRs
interface.longDescription: Praxis is an agent workflow for software development. It clarifies requirements, designs the data model and API, builds each story test-first in an isolated git worktree as stacked single-concern PRs, and reviews every story with a fresh reviewer. It runs on autopilot or pauses after every step, and it never pushes without your word.
defaultPrompt: Use Praxis to build this feature.
Resume the Praxis run for this feature.
Publish the Praxis PRs for this feature.
